summary.text: Nicholas Hanson is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 9A, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works in sales, and in a Ballotpedia survey he described himself as a single father.

paragraphs.text: Nicholas Hanson earned a high school diploma from Underwood Public Schools and an associate degree from the North Dakota State College of Science in 2012.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has spent 11 years in sales focused on industrial, construction and agriculture, and worked in construction and manufacturing jobs after high school.
Hanson said his key campaign messages are rural representation, following the Constitution, and investment in communities, including infrastructure, housing, health care and schools.
